thesis: A neural network inside a physics solver, fed by buried fiber under one Utqiagvik road, learns the hidden soil as data arrives, and the work now isn't the algorithm, it's the years of record and the fiber in the ground before the steep part of the thaw curve arrives.
falsifiable_by: A public accuracy number or second site showing the twin drifting from borehole and field checks (c12, c13, c22, c26), or a sourced deployment (c24).
supporting_facts: c7+c8+c9 physics carries what's known, network estimates the uncertain soil
c2+c3+c4 two 1 km cables, Sept 2021 to June 2024, 100 meters
c11 as new data arrives the twin adjusts
counterpoint_scene: THE TEST: one road, one town, 100 meters, no public accuracy number, predicts temperature not failure, not deployed (c22 to c26); drawn at full strength, the model survives as a method and narrows as a tool.
